questions.question: How does the servant in Isaiah 50 respond to those who strike and mock him?
options: He summons up a very great and mighty army to rise up and defend his honor and his name
He gives his back to those who strike and does not hide from disgrace and spitting
He flees away in great haste from the city to escape out of their cruel hands
He calls down fire from heaven above to consume all of his enemies at once
questions.answer: He gives his back to those who strike and does not hide from disgrace and spitting

questions.question: What helps the servant endure, according to Isaiah 50?
options: His own very great strength carries him through every single trial that comes
The Lord GOD helps him, so he sets his face like a flint and is not disgraced
His very many faithful followers all stand and fight bravely beside him
His abundant wealth easily buys for him the favor of all the powerful
questions.answer: The Lord GOD helps him, so he sets his face like a flint and is not disgraced
